pricePage.title: Pricing
pricePage.description1: We understand that trusting us with your assets is a serious matter. That is why we take our work on recovering your lost assets very seriously. Our expertise and knowledge in cryptocurrency asset recovery set us apart and allow us to work on wallet password recovery so that you can regain access to your assets.
pricePage.description2: We also understand that the cryptocurrency recovery process often involves sensitive personal and financial information. Therefore, we handle every case with the highest level of security and confidentiality.
pricePage.description3: For password recovery, we charge a commission of 25% of the recovered tokens. This reflects the value we provide through our expertise and secure handling of every case.
pricePage.description4: And here is the best part: our service is success-based. This means you pay us only if your assets are successfully recovered. If recovery is unsuccessful, you do not pay. We believe our words should match our actions, and we are confident in our ability to help you regain access to your assets.
